json.overall_experience: The Market Research Specialist likely found BambooHR to be a straightforward and generally effective tool for their time tracking needs. Its ease of use for daily clock-ins and PTO requests was probably appreciated. However, they might have encountered some limitations in advanced time tracking functionalities or reporting, leading to a slightly less enthusiastic view on its overall value.
